actions.script: sourceText = cons.available != 'Y' ? 'No Constitution is available.' : cons.customized == 'Y' ? 'This instance has its own Constitution (runtime/conf/Constitution.json).' : 'This instance uses the shipped Constitution (framework/docs/Constitution.json).' hashText = cons.contentHash ? String(cons.contentHash).substring(0, 12) : '' diagnosticList = (cons.diagnosticList || []).map((text) => ({text}))

label.text: Content hash ${hashText}; organizations with their own document are not affected by changes here.
